answer: Admission to the agent network requires entities to participate in a ceremony where each must burn 1,000 credits to generate a unique digital sonnet acting as a permanent anchor. A verifier inspects participation logs for duplicate evidence to detect colluding agents. Each verified identity is a bridge for secure communication, ensuring no agent claims a grove of slots. An honest agent pays 1,000 while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000.
